info.title: API.SH: Mango
info.description: The Mango API from API.SH: public Mango data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Every colour of a product (id and name) with each size's label, id and current online availability in the chosen market (size ids match `sizes[].size_id` of /mango/v1/product). A light call for frequent stock checks.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mango-availability

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A shop.mango.com product link (its colour limits the answer to that colour). Give this or `id`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The product's 8-digit reference (in its link), e.g. `37006332`; `37006332/96` also selects colour 96. Give this or `url`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market as a two-letter country code (e.g. CH, DE, AT, ES, FR, GB, US): sets the price, currency and stock. Default: the link's country, else US.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Two-digit colour id to keep (default: every colour).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: Wool blazer with a high collar

get.description:
The current best sellers of a Mango shop in one market (up to 30 items in one answer, in the shop's current order): product id and colour id, name, colour, price with ISO currency, family, link and images.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mango-bestsellers

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market as a two-letter country code (e.g. CH, DE, AT, ES, FR, GB, US): sets prices, currency and availability. Default US.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Two-letter language of names (e.g. de, fr, en). Default: the country's shop language (de for CH, DE and AT), else en.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Return at most this many items, 1-30 (default 30). The shop reorders its best sellers on every request, so the list comes in one answer.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: false: ids, price, in-stock sizes and main image only (faster); default true adds name, colour name, price with ISO currency, family, link and images for each item.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

items.name: Blazer aus Wolle mit Stehkragen
items.name_en: Wool blazer with a high collar

get.description:
A Mango shop's category menu for one country and language: every line (women, men, teen, kids, home) with its sections and categories, each with its name, type, catalog id (the id /mango/v1/category takes), level, link and subcategories.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mango-categories

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market as a two-letter country code (e.g. CH, DE, AT, ES, FR, GB, US): sets prices, currency and availability. Default US.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Two-letter language of names (e.g. de, fr, en). Default: the country's shop language (de for CH, DE and AT), else en.

parameters.name: line
parameters.description: Only this line's menu (default: every line).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every product of one Mango category in one market with the site's filters (colour group, size in stock, subfamily, price range) and sort (recommended, price_asc, price_desc): each item's product id and colour id, price, sizes in stock, and (details) name, colour, previous price, ISO currency, link and images. Facets list each colour group, size and subfamily with its count and the price range. A category is a catalog id from /mango/v1/categories or a category link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mango-category

parameters.name: catalog
parameters.description: Catalog id from /mango/v1/categories (e.g. prendas_she.abrigos_she for women's coats). Give this or `url`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A shop.mango.com category link (…/c/damen/mantel/d1b967bc); its country and language are used unless given.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market as a two-letter country code (e.g. CH, DE, AT, ES, FR, GB, US): sets prices, currency and availability. Default US.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Two-letter language of names (e.g. de, fr, en). Default: the country's shop language (de for CH, DE and AT), else en.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: recommended (the site's, default), price_asc or price_desc.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Colour group(s) by id or name from facets.colors (e.g. Schwarz or 1); comma-separate or repeat for several.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size(s) in stock (e.g. M, XL); comma-separate or repeat for several.

parameters.name: subfamily
parameters.description: Subfamily id(s) or name(s) from facets.subfamilies (e.g. Lana).

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price in the market's currency.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price in the market's currency.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-based). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Items per page, 1-48 (default 24).

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: false: ids, price, in-stock sizes and main image only (faster); default true adds name, colour name, price with ISO currency, family, link and images for each item.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

items.name: Manteco-Wollmantel mit Schalkragen
items.name_en: Manteco wool coat with funnel neck

get.description:
One Mango product in one market: name (and English name), model, collection, family, the selected colour's price, previous price and ISO currency (e.g. CHF, EUR), its sizes with online availability, and every colour of the product with its id, price, currency, sizes, images and link (colours sold under another reference carry that `product_id`). 404 when the product is not sold in that market.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mango-product

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A shop.mango.com product link; its country, language and colour are used unless given. Give this or `id`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The product's 8-digit reference (in its link), e.g. `37006332`; `37006332/96` also selects colour 96. Give this or `url`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market as a two-letter country code (e.g. CH, DE, AT, ES, FR, GB, US): sets the price, currency and stock. Default: the link's country, else US.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Two-letter language of names and labels (e.g. de, fr, en). Default: the link's, else en.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Two-digit colour id (colors[].id) to select; default: the link's colour, else the first of this reference.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: Wool blazer with a high collar
example.name_en: Wool blazer with a high collar

get.description:
Products on Mango for keywords in one market and line (women, men, teen, kids, home), in the site's relevance order: each item's product id and colour id, name, colour, price, previous price and ISO currency, family, link and images, plus the number of results in every line. The whole result list is read at once, so `total` is exact and pages are stable.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mango-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market as a two-letter country code (e.g. CH, DE, AT, ES, FR, GB, US): sets prices, currency and availability. Default US.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Two-letter language of names (e.g. de, fr, en). Default: the country's shop language (de for CH, DE and AT), else en.

parameters.name: line
parameters.description: Line to search: she (women, default), he (men), teen, kids or home; also women, men.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-based). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Items per page, 1-48 (default 24).

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: false: ids, price, in-stock sizes and main image only (faster); default true adds name, colour name, price with ISO currency, family, link and images for each item.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

items.name: Wool blazer with a high collar
items.name_en: Wool blazer with a high collar

get.description:
Mango stores of one country: id, address, city, postal code, shopping center, coordinates, lines sold (women, men, kids...), express click and collect, and the store page link; nearest first with the distance when a point is given, filtered by text with `q`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mango-stores

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market as a two-letter country code (e.g. CH, DE, AT, ES, FR, GB, US): sets prices, currency and availability. Default US.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the point to sort by distance (with `lon`).

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude of that point.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keep stores whose address, city, postal code or shopping center contains this text.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Return at most this many stores (default all).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Two-letter language of names (e.g. de, fr, en). Default: the country's shop language (de for CH, DE and AT), else en.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
